scope: Sections and custom show names/order/membership; slide deletion and duplication membership consistency
scope_method: Retain the complete union of prior slide identity/order, removal and duplication case receipts, plus named-show action metadata cases. Every parameter/example remains a separate row with exact canonical behavior pointer. There are no section/show container-edit public APIs or corresponding source cases in the pinned inventory. Adjacent action API tests are not counted as implemented membership API parity.

mapping_decisions.J01: New byte operation methods are additive, not replacements for the neutral snake_case live model. CLI sections/shows resources map to the same domain operation; no blanket alias layer.
mapping_decisions.J02: Stable section/show IDs survive edits. Byte-operation selections are source-fingerprinted immutable queries, not live owned model handles; live owner identity and invalidation remain pending.
mapping_decisions.J03: CLI member positions and insertion positions are one-based. Byte SDK SelectionQuery retains explicit coordinateSystem. Arrays preserve source order, while section membership requires contiguity and nonoverlap; newly supplied show membership rejects duplicates.
mapping_decisions.J04: Named-show action enum metadata remains in the public API register and is not implemented by container CRUD.
mapping_decisions.J05: Empty membership creation/replacement fails. Hidden slides remain normal member candidates; hidden does not mean absent.
mapping_decisions.J06: Admission and returned package bytes are always asynchronous with explicit OfficeContext capabilities. No ambient filesystem, native runtime, downloads or output publication in domain helpers.
mapping_decisions.J07: Existing action and extension metadata is never activated. IDs are derived deterministically without ambient clock or randomness.
mapping_decisions.J08: Typed OfficeError and common stable codes retain schema/usage exit 2 versus domain failure exit 1. Publication errors and limits retain shared exit mappings; failures publish no bytes.
mapping_decisions.J09: Namespace-aware edits preserve supported container extension payloads and stable identifiers; unsupported section extension semantics reject edits rather than infer references. Bounded public model XML/part views remain separate obligations.
mapping_decisions.J10: Plural sections/shows list/get/add/set/remove use common version-1 results, dotted operation IDs, camelCase SDK options, explicit output/inPlace, dryRun, selectors and schema/capability discovery.

documentation_reconciliation: Pinned audits describe historical research status, not current operation availability; this receipt makes no whole-model parity claim.
Existing repeated custom show entries are retained by unrelated edits and cleaned individually on slide deletion. Newly supplied duplicate member positions remain invalid under format section 6.4.

Slide deletion automatically removes section/show memberships and empty containers. Explicit referencePolicy=remove remains necessary for affected supported navigation links. This supersedes the earlier removal receipt and usage statement requiring policy for memberships.

Slide duplication leaves custom show membership unchanged. An insertion strictly inside a section span adds copies to that section to preserve contiguity; boundary/outside insertion does not infer membership.
Names do not rename package parts. Duplicate labels do not replace or merge stable identities; selectors must resolve ambiguity.

Empty display names are intentional under format section 6.3; only lookup names and identifiers require nonempty values. Duplicate display labels remain distinct identities and ambiguous name lookup fails.

The prior shows command table omitted position despite the requested reorder behavior and SDK parity requirement. Show add/set now expose position like sections; one-based add positions are insertion slots and set positions are final list order.

original_operation_assertions.behavior: Create, rename, reorder and remove containers; replace memberships; assert stable IDs, XML order and untouched extensions independently. Empty memberships, names, duplicate labels, hidden slide members, existing repeated show entries and unsupported extension structures have explicit outcomes.
Delete without reference policy, prune all repeated references to each deleted slide, preserve unaffected IDs/extensions, remove emptied containers.
Inserted copies acquire section membership only inside a section span; retain show membership and original IDs. Assert saved XML rather than deriving expected output from editor helpers.
